name: Cardamom-Kiln Caldera
core_rationale: Eleventh spice-glaze ceramic caldera of Hearthbloom Basin where Sola's warm mineral springs steep wild cardamom pods inside tiered porcelain drying kilns.
local_conflict: Aromatic glaze-wisps and terracotta mortar beetles guard the warm cardamom drying domes.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Bathhouse keepers in Ginger-Bathhouse Haven say the eastern Cardamom-Kiln Caldera simmers with spiced porcelain glaze-springs that glow amber beneath the evening mist.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: Dome-shaped cardamom drying kilns and terraced porcelain glaze-basins rising beyond the northern rim above Ginger-Steam Terraces.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: Which Primordial Kiln-Artisan carved the central spice-glaze crucible of Cardamom-Kiln Caldera?

geography.biome: A caldera bowl on the north rim, green-grey rock around mineral springs and tiered drying kilns; old forest fills a hidden valley on its southern flank.

weather.name: Caldera cloud
weather.feel: Cloud fills the bowl from the springs and sits level with the rim.

weather.name: Spring glow
weather.feel: Amber light lifts off the glaze basins and carries a cardamom smell across the rim.

weather.name: Valley rain
weather.feel: Heavy drops fall on the forest below the rim and the leaves hiss loudly.

geography.water: Mineral springs fill the central glaze basins and spill south over the rim, forming the head of the Glaze River, which runs down through the forested valley toward Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff.
geography.far_landmark: An amber glow lifting from behind the caldera rim, with the tops of the drying domes just showing, seen north-north-east from Cinnamon-Bellows Bluff.
discovery_hooks: A cracked drying dome with a ring of spent cardamom pods inside.
A spillway where the spring water runs over green-grey glaze in a perfect fan and sounds like a struck cup.

encounter_bands.identity: Late Ch II elite expedition, later-story foreshadowing
encounter_bands.source: ChatGPT 'World Structure Merge Proposal v1', 2026-11-18, section 3.2

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-sola-hearth-weaver and scar-kiln-basin along the north-western geothermal rim of Continent 01.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Dome-shaped cardamom drying kilns and terraced porcelain glaze-basins simmering in perpetual spring warmth.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Mystery status: porcelain kiln doorway and drying-terrace metrics for 1.05m characters will be verified upon promotion to Draft.
